entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-06-09
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • dotnetup: install to user-local location when `$host$` is in `global.json`'s `sdk.paths` #54658
  • ProjectReference copies AppHostIntermediatePath instead of output, causing referenced EXE to not reflect post-build changes (workaround included) #54654
  • Microsoft Security Advisory CVE-2026-45490 | .NET SDK Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability #54652
  • Regression: blazor.webassembly.js not found #54650

Closed

  • Updating patch version does not cleanly remove old SDKs #34764
  • The FrameworkReference 'NETStandard.Library' was not recognized - Xamarin.Forms vs4mac #34662
  • `process.StandardOutput.ReadToEnd()` never finishes for `dotnet build` in unit tests in certain situations on Windows #34653
  • Multiple SDKs not supported on Dotnet SDK installed as Snap #34593
  • dotnet build fails to build project in path which contains symbolic link ($TMPDIR) on Mac. #34442
  • dotnet workload maui install error #54656
  • Add a GHA workflow that would prevent merging features on servicing branches without going through servicing approval #54640
  • [dnceng-bot] Branch `sdk/release/9.0.3xx` can't be merged to Azdo internal branch #54369
  • Error when TargetFramework missing is problematic #54308
  • Ensure dotnet test for MTP cancellation is handled correctly #50732
  • Add test counts to per-assembly summaries #52128
